purpose: Define Editor monitors as read-only projections over canonical/runtime observability surfaces such as site map, Trigger/Event/Runner activity, DWH and q activity.

topics.name: Monitors
topics.purpose: Define Editor monitors as read-only projections over canonical/runtime observability surfaces such as site map, Trigger/Event/Runner activity, DWH and q activity.

semantics.source_rule: Monitor data comes from explicit canonical/runtime state and trace surfaces.
semantics.authority_rule: Observing a resource does not grant control authority.
semantics.trace_rule: Displayed activity retains identity/provenance where available.
semantics.projection_rule: Filtering/sorting/layout are monitor presentation semantics only.
semantics.action_rule: Any control action exposed alongside a monitor invokes a separate explicit canonical operation.

invariants.rule: Editor subtools are projections/operation surfaces over canonical semantics and do not become independent authorities.

hard_gates.condition: monitor becomes semantic source of truth
monitor display ordering interpreted as runtime causality
activity data loses identity/provenance required for deterministic trace
control action mutates runtime directly without canonical operation

prose.summary: Define Editor monitors as read-only projections over canonical/runtime observability surfaces such as site map, Trigger/Event/Runner activity, DWH and q activity.
